description: Documentation for locally supplied quarterly S&P AI/other market-cap inputs. Observations and the detailed gain ledger are excluded from public Git; contemporaneous ownership weights are shifted once by the model.

market_cap.source: User-supplied ai_market_cap_data.xlsx from the existing AI wealth-effects calculation
market_cap.unit_confirmation: User explicitly confirmed divide S&P total by 1,000 on October 15, 2026
market_cap.non_ai_definition: S&P total minus S&P-specific AI-linked market capitalization
market_cap.input_freeze: September 2026 existing AI-research snapshot; market-cap file contains observations through August, only complete quarters through June are used
market_cap.public_provenance: Market-cap workbook vendor, constituent classification, adjustment history and redistribution license are not established by the source manifest. Source observations, derived quarterly capitalization input and the detailed gain ledger are not included in the public repository.
market_cap.valuation_limit: Changes in capitalization may contain issuance, repurchases, index membership changes and classification changes as well as prices. No constituent decomposition is supplied.

ownership.source: Federal Reserve Financial Accounts proxy already cached in the AI wealth study
ownership.numerator: LM153064475 household and nonprofit direct and indirect corporate equity holdings
ownership.denominator: LM893064105 total corporate equity liability/market value proxy
ownership.timing: Input rows are contemporaneous; the runner uses t-1 values
ownership.scope: Broad household/nonprofit beneficial equity proxy includes indirect holdings and DC pensions once; numerator and denominator are not a measured household share of S&P capitalization. Private/foreign/sector-boundary mismatch makes application to S&P an assumption.

income_group_shares.source: Federal Reserve Distributional Financial Accounts by income, frozen with the existing ECM inputs
income_group_shares.series: Corporate equities and mutual fund shares
income_group_shares.raw_units: USD millions, divided by 1000 before aggregation
income_group_shares.timing: Input rows are contemporaneous; the runner uses t-1 values
income_group_shares.assumption: Same S&P AI/other mix within each income group. Group weights exclude unknown equity look-through inside pension entitlements and are a proxy for distributing aggregate beneficial ownership; full pension balances are not added as equities.

deflator: PCE price from data/quarterly_panel.csv; cumulative nominal allocated gains divided by current price, 2017=1
vintage_mismatch: Original ECM GDP/PCE August 26, 2026 vintage retained; existing AI input snapshot is later. No silent vintage harmonization.

publication_policy.included: Code, methodology, metadata, publication charts and derived ECM estimates
publication_policy.reproduction: Supply the capitalization input locally using docs/AI_ECM_SPLIT.md; no source observations or substitute data are embedded in the public code.
